ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from editing existing Assessment Question Response records when the related Assessment has the PHOCSAssessment Record Type and an Assessment Type of Risk Assessment or Risk re-assessment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), Assessment.RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSAssessment", OR( ISPICKVAL(Assessment.Type, "Risk re-assessment"), ISPICKVAL(Assessment.Type, "Risk Assessment") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assessment Question Response cannot be edited for PHOCS Risk Assessments.
